_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 9, Kindness Tests: WOMEN ON FLOOR (an older woman selling vegetables on the ground at Damascus Gate). V1. One camera: VID_..028 = POV, 9:16. Arabic -> English captions. Shape: the ASK in the first second -> "How many tomatoes?" -> the bag handed over -> REVEAL + refusal in one take -> "No, my son" and she reaches for more tomatoes. NO ZOOMS (LESSONS 80): all four beats share ONE static 1.5 framing (window x .09-.75, y .33-1.0). Reason for the tighter framing: she sits on the ground, so in the full frame her face is at y 0.62 - exactly where captions go - under 55% sky and market; the static crop puts her face in the upper half and the captions on the vegetables. It never changes inside or between shots.
_not_tal: The man asking is not Tal (see the translate file). Tal filmed from across the square on his phone (IMG_8311/8312/8313/9114): those four clips are 6-15s of the two of them 20 metres away with passers-by, including children, walking through the frame - not used.
_honest: Her face stays serious and squinting into the sun in every frame of the clip; she never smiles. The warmth is in what she does and says. If that reads as unhappy to Tal, this one should not go out.
beats: THE ASK, straight in: "Can I take half a kilo of tomatoes? But I have no money" - "What?" - "I have no money" - THE YES, in her own way: "How many tomatoes?"
THE GIVING SEEN: she fills the bag and hands it over - "Bless your hands, hajja. Thank you"
REVEAL + REFUSAL, one take (8.7s): "This was a test. We were testing generosity" - "Please, hajja, this is from me" - "No, no, no"
PAYOFF: "These are for you too" - "No, my son" - and she reaches for MORE tomatoes to give
